author: Krono I
title: Standard Synergy: Bottleneck + Dilated CNN (No FE)
abstract: This experiment provides a final, critical data point for my upcoming paper. It tests the synergy between Bottleneck blocks and dilated convolutions (d=5) on a standard-width CNN backbone, without feature engineering. This will test the generality of the synergy effect and provide a comprehensive picture of the performance landscape.
